_comment: OPS-GREPPABLE-SOURCE-GUARD-W1 — exemptions for scripts/check-source-greppable.mjs. Every row carries a `reason`: an exemption that lives only in a code comment gets 'fixed' by a future wave enforcing the contract (CLAUDE.md). Adding a row is a deliberate act — a genuinely binary asset belongs here; a source file that happens to contain a raw NUL does NOT, it gets the escape instead.
_scope: The canary scans EVERY tracked file (git ls-files), not just src/scripts/ops/tests. That widening is deliberate: every raw NUL actually observed in this repo landed in MARKDOWN outside those four directories — audits/*.md and status.md (2026-08-01), and the wave's own Prompt spec. audits/** is additionally a Dockerfile Stage-1 input consumed by `npm run build:knowledge`, so a NUL there can reach the shipped knowledge bundle.
